goal: port the GAP9 SDK's NE16 techniques into our flow and run SpeechNet QZO on GAP9 with NE16
status: COMPLETE -- SpeechNet QZO runs on GAP9 with NE16 and is BIT-IDENTICAL to the cluster-only baseline

phase1_pipelined_dispatch.technique: SDK technique A (KerConv1D_StrideS_NE16): block only while NE16's 2-deep job queue is full; resolve once after the whole tap chain
phase1_pipelined_dispatch.correction: This CORRECTS exp16b's interpretation. exp16b called the layer 'DMA- and setup-bound' and I read setup as job programming; removing nearly all of that programming cost buys only 1.65%, so the dominant term is the int32 streamin round-trips through L1, not register writes. SDK technique B (10 register writes instead of 24) is therefore dropped; technique C (im2col channel folding) matters more since it removes streamin outright.

phase2_automatic_pass.what: NE16Prepare1xKPass rewrites a plain 1xK/Kx1 Conv into the NE16 form: per-tap stacked bit-serial weight (host-side for a constant, NE16WeightEncode inserted for a runtime one), ne16_taps / weight_offset / ne16_weight_preencoded, and channels_first=1 on the un-merged RequantShift
phase2_automatic_pass.note: plain = ordinary NCHW Conv with a runtime weight from RQSPerturbRademacher and ZERO NE16 attributes; slightly slower than the hand-authored NHWC fixtures (176,503 / 142,915) because the plain graph pays for the layout Transposes

phase3_full_network.result: PASSED, Errors: 0 out of 8 (the harness's optimizer-output check)
phase3_full_network.which: blocks 3 and 4 (7x1, unpadded) on NE16; blocks 0/1/2 on the cluster because they are padded
phase3_full_network.reproducible: yes -- two independent runs produced identical loss bits

coverage_limit.issue: NE16Prepare1xKPass refuses PADDED convolutions, so SpeechNet blocks 0/1/2 (pads [0,2,0,2], [0,8,0,8], [0,4,0,4]) stay on the cluster -- only 5.8% of conv MACs reach NE16.
coverage_limit.why: NE16's 1x1 mode cannot pad and its gvsoc guard (fsm.cpp:53) is COMMENTED OUT, so a padded job returns wrong results rather than trapping. Every fixture so far pre-padded the activation DATA; a real graph carries padding on the node.
coverage_limit.fix_shape: The GAP9 SDK handles it with pointer arithmetic plus border-subtile computation (NE16_ComputeBorders, CNN_BasicKernels_NE16.c), not with NE16 padding. That belongs in NE161xKConstraint.serializeTilingSolution.

rounding_bug.bug: the standalone RequantShift passed rounding=1 unconditionally, while PULPConvRequantMergePass bakes +div/2 into the add ONLY for a gs.Constant add; for a runtime (perturbed) add it bakes nothing and the fused kernel truncates
rounding_bug.effect: with div=65536 the NE16 (un-merged) path was off by exactly div/2 -- a systematic +0.5 LSB on every output element of blocks 3 and 4, amplifying to a 20-55% wrong loss
rounding_bug.why_isolated_tests_missed_it: the single-layer fixtures bake the perturbed bias in as a CONSTANT initializer, which puts them in the branch where merged and un-merged agree by construction
rounding_bug.pre_existing: the bug is older than this work but was unreachable -- with every conv fused into RequantizedConv, no standalone RequantShift with a runtime add ever existed. NE16 is the first thing to leave one un-merged, and it must, because streamin forces int32 output.
rounding_bug.fix: rqs_rounding = int(hasattr(addBuffer,'values') and addBuffer.values is not None)
rounding_bug.verified: generated C now ends both NE16 requant calls with '-128, 127, 0)'

numerical_result.verdict: NE16 is now as close to the host reference as the cluster is (marginally closer). The ~1.6e-2 residual on L+ #3 is present in the cluster baseline too -- the known pre-existing device-vs-host int8/fp32 gap.
numerical_result.residual: Against the cluster directly, six of eight passes agree to ~1e-3 or better but L- #1 differs by 1.29e-2, where the cluster tracks the host to 7e-6. A second, ~40x smaller discrepancy remains -- signature changed from uniform offset to sparse disagreement, suggesting a few 1-LSB elements rather than a systematic bias. Next to chase.

final_result.note: all eight per-pass losses match the cluster baseline bit for bit (identical fp32 hex)
final_result.interpretation: NE16's distance to the host reference is now exactly the cluster's -- the residual is the known pre-existing device-vs-host int8/fp32 gap, not an NE16 artefact

bugs_found_and_fixed.name: +div/2 rounding
bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: standalone RequantShift passed rounding=1 unconditionally; PULPConvRequantMergePass bakes +div/2 only into a CONSTANT add, so with a runtime (perturbed) bias the un-merged path was off by exactly div/2
bugs_found_and_fixed.impact: systematic +0.5 LSB on every NE16 output element -> 20-55% wrong loss
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: rqs_rounding derived from whether the add buffer is constant

bugs_found_and_fixed.name: perturb channel axis (serialize)
bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: channelDim = cube.dims[0]; once the bias is broadcast to (1,cout) this gives channel_width = cout, and the kernel's M[(start+i)/channel_width] collapses to M[0] for every channel

bugs_found_and_fixed.name: perturb axis alignment (geometry)
bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: addGeometricalConstraint paired input/output dims by raw index. The op is elementwise but the ranks differ once the OUTPUT is broadcast to (1,cout) while the input stays (cout,): data_in.dim0 (cout) was equated with data_out.dim0 (1), sizing the input tile at ONE element (4 bytes) against a 128-byte DMA
bugs_found_and_fixed.evidence: generated C showed data_in at arena+128 and mul at arena+132 -- 4 bytes apart, both receiving 128-byte transfers, a 124-byte overlap that clobbered the multipliers
bugs_found_and_fixed.impact: perturbation wrong by a constant per output channel; channel 0 correct, channels 1..31 wrong (1240/1280 on block 3)
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: align axes from the first non-unit axis, numpy-broadcast style

common_thread: All three are PRE-EXISTING Deeploy defects that were unreachable before NE16. With every convolution fused into a RequantizedConv, no standalone RequantShift with a runtime bias ever existed -- so the bias was never broadcast and the rounding branch was never taken. NE16 is the first thing to leave a conv un-merged, and it must, because streamin forces int32 output.
